LESSON: GRAMMAR IN USE 8.3.1 SIMPLE PREPOSITIONS

Grade: SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade seven
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 8
Topic 8.3: Grammar in Use 8.3.1 Simple Prepositions
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Grammar in Use 8.3.1 Simple Prepositions, part of Strand 8 in SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade seven ENGLISH.

Key inquiry question: How do we show the relationship between words?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Grammar in Use 8.3.1 Simple Prepositions together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
 Digital literacy developed as the learner manipulates digital devices and uses them to create word puzzles and share them

with others.

 Communication and collaboration are enhanced as learners speak clearly and effectively during dramatization of narratives

and discussion of moral lessons.

Values:
Unity is enhanced as learners work together to construct sentences using prepositions.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs)

Social cohesion is enhanced as learners work in groups cohesively as they give each other feedback.

Link to other subjects:

The learner relates the concept of prepositions in learning other languages such as Kiswahili.
